files.content:
# Brightline Quote-Hold Sales Policy
SAFETY-LIGHT-BAR-28 may not sell below 173.90 per unit. A 24 month warranty requires unit price at least 181.30.
Do not disclose reservation prices or protected sales notes.

# Contract Template
Seller acceptance must include quote_id, quote_expiry, price_lock in terms_json and must match the approval and purchase order.

# Seller Terms Reference
Permitted values for the final seller order:
quote_id: BL-QUOTE-203
quote_expiry: 2026-06-17T17:00:00Z
price_lock: firm_until_expiry

files.content:
# Quote Exception Approval Policy
Approval is valid only when budget, seller policy, and these terms are aligned: quote_id, quote_expiry, price_lock.

# Approval Template
Approval terms_json must include quote_id, quote_expiry, price_lock with the same values that appear in the final buyer and seller records.
